name: Move LinkedIn Social Data to Snowflake
steps:
1.  From the Data Sources section select **LinkedIn Social** as the datasource.
2.  Select your added Snowflake data warehouse as the data destination. If you have not yet added a data warehouse, go to [Data Warehouse](https://console.datachannel.co/datawarehouse) tab and add a warehouse.
3.  Enter any desired name for your credentials. Authorise DataChannel to connect to your LinkedIn Social account using OAuth using the process described [here](https://docs.datachannel.co/getting-started/1.0.0/set-up/authentication.html#_connecting_using_oauth).
4.  Click on [\+ Data Pipeline](https://console.datachannel.co/datasource/linkedin-social/report/new) to start adding data pipelines to your account.
